ID: WF-001
Workflow Name: Purchase Approval
Description: This workflow manages the approval process for purchase requests raised by employees.
Metadata:
  Current Stage: Manager Approval
  Current Approver: Department Manager
  Next Step: Finance Approval
  SLA: 24 Hours
Stages:
  Name: Request Submission
  Description: Employee submits a purchase request.

  Name: Manager Approval
  Description: Department Manager reviews and approves the purchase request.

  Name: Finance Approval
  Description: Finance validates budget availability and approves the request.

  Name: Procurement
  Description: Procurement team creates the Purchase Order.

  Name: Completed
  Description: Purchase Order is issued successfully.

Business Rules:
  Condition: Amount <= ₹50,000
  Action: Only Manager Approval is required.

  Condition: Amount > ₹50,000
  Action: Finance Approval is mandatory.

  Condition: Amount > ₹500,000
  Action: Director Approval is also required.

  Condition: Vendor is new

faq.question: Why is my purchase request pending?
faq.answer: Your request is waiting for the current approver to complete their review.

faq.question: Who approves after the manager?
faq.answer: Finance Department approves after Manager Approval.

faq.question: Can I edit my request after submission?
faq.answer: No. Once submitted, the request cannot be edited until it is rejected.

faq.question: What happens after Finance Approval?
faq.answer: The request moves to Procurement for Purchase Order creation.

faq.question: What is the SLA for Manager Approval?
